item.title: Moral Meanings, Pharmaceutical Technologies, and Global Inequities in the Era of New Weight Loss Drugs
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how the development and global circulation of new weight loss pharmaceutical technologies raise urgent questions about moral meanings, social inequities, and the politics of health. We invite submissions that critically analyze the social, cultural, economic, and ethical dimensions of these technologies across diverse global contexts.

Timeline

  • October 1, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
item.author: Social Science & Medicine (ELSEVIER)
